values.value:
• "No matching dataset": The source report's root object isn't covered by any CR_Dataset record. Add a dataset for that object first (Setup → Custom Metadata → CR Dataset).
  • "Field not in dataset" warnings: The source report references a field that the matched dataset doesn't expose. Either add the field path to the dataset, or remove that column from the migrated report.
  • Migration runs forever: Cross-filter or cross-block reports (Salesforce's Joined Reports) need a different path — use Joined Report Builder instead.
